interface.signature: def isEulerCircuilt(V: int, adj: List[List[int]]) -> int

preconditions.description: The number of vertices V must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= len(adj[i]) <= 10000 for i in range(V))
preconditions.description: Each vertex's adjacency list must contain between 0 and 10,000 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= neighbor < V for neighbor in adj[i]) for i in range(V))
preconditions.description: All neighbors in the adjacency list must be valid vertex indices.

postconditions.description: The function must return 0, 1, or 2 indicating the type of Eulerian path or circuit.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 2 and all(degree[i] % 2 == 0 for i in range(V))
postconditions.description: If the function returns 2, all vertices must have even degrees, indicating an Eulerian circuit.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 and sum(1 for i in range(V) if degree[i] % 2 != 0) == 2
postconditions.description: If the function returns 1, exactly two vertices must have odd degrees, indicating an Eulerian path.
